title: Application verdict of one proxied HTTP request
description: The enterprise App-ID verdict of go/detector AppClassifier (PRO-492): the catalog application of the server name and, when a child-app rule of the content data matched, the child application per function with its container. A rule only refines the catalog's identity. limit names a work ceiling that was hit (never silent); a verdict with a limit names no child. No path, content type, body or credential is recorded; app, container and rule are content-data names.

app.description: The child application when a child rule matched, else the catalog application of the server name, else empty

container.description: The parent of app when app is a child application, else empty

rule.description: <child>#<rule index> of the matched rule, else empty
